mapper.select: SELECT cm.id, cm.session_id, cm.sender_id, CASE WHEN cm.sender_type = 1 THEN s.nick_name WHEN cm.sender_type = 2 THEN e.enterprise_name ELSE '' END AS sender_name, CASE WHEN cm.sender_type = 1 THEN s.head_image WHEN cm.sender_type = 2 THEN e.logo ELSE '' END AS sender_avatar, cm.sender_type, cm.receiver_id, CASE WHEN cm.receiver_type = 1 THEN s2.nick_name WHEN cm.receiver_type = 2 THEN e2.enterprise_name ELSE '' END AS receiver_name, CASE WHEN cm.receiver_type = 1 THEN s2.head_image WHEN cm.receiver_type = 2 THEN e2.logo ELSE '' END AS receiver_avatar, cm.receiver_type, cm.message_type, cm.content, cm.related_job_id, cm.is_read, cm.read_time, cm.create_time FROM chat_message cm LEFT JOIN student s ON cm.sender_type = 1 AND cm.sender_id = s.id LEFT JOIN enterprise e ON cm.sender_type = 2 AND cm.sender_id = e.id LEFT JOIN student s2 ON cm.receiver_type = 1 AND cm.receiver_id = s2.id LEFT JOIN enterprise e2 ON cm.receiver_type = 2 AND cm.receiver_id = e2.id WHERE cm.session_id = #{sessionId} ORDER BY cm.create_time DESC
SELECT COALESCE(SUM(enterprise_unread_count), 0) FROM chat_session WHERE enterprise_id = #{enterpriseId} AND status = 1
